name: tinto-batch-book-hotel-rooms
description: Requesting a new seasonal hotel room hold, checking for and interpreting the hotel's reply (proposed to Tamara for confirmation, never written automatically), or converting a confirmed block into a sold tour's actual booking (including bridging the net sellable rooms into Hotel Rooms Booked w/ Hotel) — writing to the production base's Hotel Rooms Requested, Hotel Rooms Booked w/ Hotel, and Supplier Booking Lead Times tables. A standalone plugin, open to whoever manages hotel blocks (typically Tamara or Nélia), separate from the restricted tinto-logistics daily-cycle plugin.
